1	/**
2	 * Server-side feature gating.
3	 *
4	 * Two modes:
5	 *  1. RPC-based (production): calls check_feature_access RPC — respects feature_flags overrides + plan features jsonb.
6	 *  2. Static fallback: PLAN_ORDER comparison for when RPC is unavailable (e.g. test env).
7	 *
8	 * NEVER call check_feature_access from Client Components — server-side only.
9	 */
10	
11	import type { SupabaseClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js'
12	import { logger } from '@/lib/logger'
13	
14	export type PlanTier = 'solo' | 'studio' | 'pro' | 'enterprise'
15	
16	export const PLAN_ORDER: Record<PlanTier, number> = {
17	  solo: 0,
18	  studio: 1,
19	  pro: 2,
20	  enterprise: 3,
21	}
22	
23	/**
24	 * Canonical set of feature keys — must match the plan features JSONB in the DB.
25	 * If this set drifts from DB values, requireFeatureRpc() will universally 403.
26	 * Run warnOnFeatureKeyDrift() at startup to surface any mismatch early.
27	 */
28	export const KNOWN_FEATURE_KEYS = new Set([
29	  'booking',
30	  'calendar',
31	  'public_booking_page',
32	  'digital_consent',
33	  'client_crm',
34	  'dodo_payments',
35	  'inventory',
36	  'commissions',
37	  'payroll',
38	  'ai_design',
39	  'ai_design_assistant',
40	  'guest_artists',
41	  'eu_reach',
42	  'multi_location',
43	  'custom_domain',
44	  'api_access',
45	  'sms_reminders',
46	  'analytics',
47	  'white_label',
48	  'marketing_basic',
49	  'marketing_advanced',
50	  'calendar_sync',
51	  'referral_program',
52	  'omnichannel_inbox',
53	  'messaging_ai_replies',
54	  'projects',
55	])
56	
57	/**
58	 * Called at server startup (e.g. instrumentation.ts) to warn if plan JSONB
59	 * contains keys not in KNOWN_FEATURE_KEYS — catches future key drift early.
60	 * Never throws; degraded gracefully.
61	 */
62	export async function warnOnFeatureKeyDrift(supabase: SupabaseClient): Promise<void> {
63	  try {
64	    const { data, error } = await supabase
65	      .from('plans')
66	      .select('name, features')
67	      .eq('is_active', true)
68	    if (error || !data) return
69	
70	    for (const plan of data) {
71	      const keys = plan.features as string[] | null
72	      if (!Array.isArray(keys)) continue
73	      for (const key of keys) {
74	        if (!KNOWN_FEATURE_KEYS.has(key)) {
75	          logger.warn(
76	            { plan: plan.name, unknownKey: key },
77	            'feature-gate: plan contains unknown feature key — check_feature_access may 403 unexpectedly',
78	          )
79	        }
80	      }
81	    }
82	  } catch {
83	    // Startup check — never block server init
84	  }
85	}
86	
87	/** Minimum plan required for each feature key (static fallback) */
88	const FEATURE_MIN_PLAN: Record<string, PlanTier> = {
89	  inventory: 'studio',
90	  commissions: 'studio',
91	  payroll: 'pro',
92	  ai_design: 'pro',
93	  ai_design_assistant: 'pro',
94	  guest_artists: 'pro',
95	  eu_reach: 'pro',
96	  multi_location: 'pro',
97	  white_label: 'enterprise',
98	  api_access: 'enterprise',
99	  sms_reminders: 'studio',
100	  analytics: 'pro',
101	  marketing_basic: 'studio',
102	  marketing_advanced: 'studio',
103	  calendar_sync: 'studio',
104	  referral_program: 'studio',
105	  omnichannel_inbox: 'studio',
106	  messaging_ai_replies: 'pro',
107	  projects: 'pro',
108	}
109	
110	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
111	// Static helpers (no DB round-trip)
112	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
113	
114	export function hasFeature(plan: PlanTier, feature: string): boolean {
115	  const minPlan = FEATURE_MIN_PLAN[feature]
116	  if (!minPlan) return true
117	  return PLAN_ORDER[plan] >= PLAN_ORDER[minPlan]
118	}
119	
120	export function requiredPlanFor(feature: string): PlanTier | null {
121	  return FEATURE_MIN_PLAN[feature] ?? null
122	}
123	
124	export function requireFeature(plan: PlanTier, feature: string): Response | null {
125	  if (hasFeature(plan, feature)) return null
126	  const required = FEATURE_MIN_PLAN[feature] ?? 'pro'
127	  return Response.json(
128	    { error: 'Feature not available on current plan', requiredPlan: required },
129	    { status: 403 },
130	  )
131	}
132	
133	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
134	// Custom error for RPC-based gating
135	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
136	
137	export class FeatureGateError extends Error {
138	  readonly featureKey: string
139	  constructor(featureKey: string) {
140	    super(`Feature '${featureKey}' is not available on current plan`)
141	    this.name = 'FeatureGateError'
142	    this.featureKey = featureKey
143	  }
144	}
145	
146	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
147	// RPC-based gating (server components + API routes)
148	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
149	
150	/**
151	 * Throws FeatureGateError if studio does not have access to featureKey.
152	 * Use in API routes: try { await requireFeatureRpc(...) } catch(e) { if e instanceof FeatureGateError return 403 }
153	 */
154	export async function requireFeatureRpc(
155	  supabase: SupabaseClient,
156	  studioId: string,
157	  featureKey: string,
158	): Promise<void> {
159	  const { data: hasAccess, error } = await supabase.rpc('check_feature_access', {
160	    p_studio_id: studioId,
161	    p_feature_key: featureKey,
162	  })
163	  if (error || !hasAccess) {
164	    throw new FeatureGateError(featureKey)
165	  }
166	}
167	
168	/**
169	 * Non-throwing variant — returns boolean.
170	 * Use in Server Components to conditionally render locked UI.
171	 */
172	export async function checkFeatureRpc(
173	  supabase: SupabaseClient,
174	  studioId: string,
175	  featureKey: string,
176	): Promise<boolean> {
177	  const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc('check_feature_access', {
178	    p_studio_id: studioId,
179	    p_feature_key: featureKey,
180	  })
181	  if (error) return false
182	  return Boolean(data)
183	}
